title: No representative post-2020 estimate of harvest and post-harvest losses
description: Loss evidence comes from field experiments and two-township rodent studies; national loss rates under current mechanization are unknown.

title: Proven nutrient decision tools never reached Myanmar farmers
description: Site-specific nutrient advice raised yields 17-19% in India (S267) and integrated recommendations scaled to 20.9 million farmers in China (S076); a Myanmar Rice Crop Manager prototype (2019) has no deployment record.

title: No operational township-level flood/drought loss monitoring
description: Relief, seed replacement and anticipatory decisions lack a near-real-time link between satellite hazard data and farm yield losses.

title: Official subnational production statistics not public after 2020
description: Analysts rely on phone panels and satellites; disagreement between sources cannot be adjudicated.

title: Quality seed does not reach farmers after shocks
description: Off-farm seed raises yields, but its use falls after shocks except near early-generation seed farms.

title: Season-ahead profitability is invisible to farmers and policymakers
description: Profit swings of +41% to -40% between seasons are only documented after the fact.

title: Precision/row seeding services absent while broadcasting spreads
description: Labour scarcity drives broadcast DSR with a perceived yield penalty; Vietnam's mechanized seeding shows an alternative.

title: Economic-optimum N rates under current prices are not estimated
description: Yield response to N is weakening under conflict (S269); recommendations ignore the urea:paddy price ratio and establishment method.

title: Coastal salinity and elevation data are thin or inconsistent
description: Satellite salinity models lack in-situ EC; elevation datasets disagree (S195).

title: Farmgate price transmission under the dual FX regime is not monitored continuously
description: FX policy hurt incentives more than conflict (S239), but no routine monitor exists.

title: No randomized evidence on digital advisory effects for rice
description: Current DCAS evidence is non-random and implementer-affiliated (S262).

title: Effect of mechanization cost spikes on timeliness losses unquantified
description: Fees rose 42-59%; consequences for harvest timing and losses are not measured.
